newsitem.title: FRANCE: France warns travellers over Ebola cases in Gabon.
newsitem.headline: France warns travellers over Ebola cases in Gabon.

text.p: France on Friday revived safety measures for travellers flying in from Gabon after the World Health Organisation (WHO) reported two fatal cases of the Ebola virus in Libreville
The Social Affairs Ministry said airline passengers were being given information leaflets on the symptoms of the disease -- headaches, high temperature, bloody diarrhoea.
They were also requested to be contactable for three weeks after arrival in France in case one of their fellow-passengers developped the disease.
It said people flying to Gabon were advised against visiting regions affected by the virus and avoid any contact with ill people.
The safety measures, first taken three months ago over an epidemics in Gabon's region of Booue, were dropped earlier this month after the epidemics appeared to be over.
